description.narrative: The UNIDO-Zambia Country Programme (CP) is designed to enhance UNIDO#s support to the Government of Zambia to implement a road-map towards Inclusive and Sustainable Industrial Development (ISID). It is aligned to and supporting the implementation of the government priorities as defined in the Revised Sixth National Development Plan (2011-2015) and reflected in the new United Nations Sustainable Development Partnership Framework (2016-2021). The program is focusing on the overall objective of supporting pro-poor economic growth through promotion of a competitive private sector with particular attention to small scale enterprises with an agro-industry orientation. Moreover, the Country Program aims at building the capacity of relevant national institutions from both the public and private sector. As industrialization is a long-term endeavor, involving many stakeholders, efforts will be made to strengthen synergies and minimize duplication by collaborating with development cooperation partners, state and non-state actors, as well as the private sector in the country.
